result.summary: Found 1 likely visual issue: a loading indicator appears stuck over a fully visible restaurant image.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image even though the image content is already visible, making the card look broken and obscuring the food image.
issues.suggestion: Hide the spinner once the image finishes loading, or fix the loading state so it does not remain visible after content has rendered.
